name: Plan
oneLiner: Describe the change, the constraints, and the official docs before any code.
goal: Give the next agent enough context that it does not guess.

steps.title: Describe the change
steps.text: Write what is changing, who it is for, and the constraints.

steps.title: Paste official docs
steps.text: Find the official documentation and paste the links into the intent.

steps.title: Define done
steps.text: List the checks that will decide the work is finished.

doneChecks.text: intent.md says what, why, for whom, the constraints, and what done means.
Every technical claim has an official docs link.

pitfalls.text: Leaving the agent to guess an API instead of pasting the official docs.

quotes.text: Go find the official docs yourself and paste the link so the agent is not guessing.

optionGroups.label: Change type
optionGroups.help: What kind of work is this?

options.label: New app
options.detail: Start a project that does not exist yet.
options.promptFragment: This is a new app. Propose the smallest structure that matches the constraints, and wait for the plan to be accepted before you add it.

options.label: Feature
options.detail: Add something to an existing project.
options.promptFragment: This is a feature on an existing project. Read the repository before proposing files. Keep the change inside the current architecture.

options.label: Bug fix
options.detail: Change an existing behavior that is wrong.
options.promptFragment: This is a bug fix. State the current behavior and the intended behavior before changing code. Touch only the files that behavior requires.

options.label: Refactor
options.detail: Change the structure and keep the behavior.
options.promptFragment: This is a refactor. Preserve the behavior a person can observe. Call out any behavior you cannot prove is unchanged.
